Moneyline parlays let you concentrate on picking winners rather than worrying about the point spread. So, they are not the bet for every occasion but if you've got some strong hunches they can be the most profitable way to go.

The app also features a 'Dutching' calculator. Dutching is the strategy of betting on more than one competitor in a race or event, with a staking plan that ensures that the potential returns (profit) are the same if any one of the chosen selections wins. It's ideal for betting on sports like golf where you might have a number of long priced fancies in a single tournament.
